summary: A member decides whether to report an improper offer as a separate act from turning it down.
realLife: Connecticut Representative Deborah Heinrich recalled telling a visitor to put away what he was showing her. She then alerted the Capitol police, who arrested him.
inGame: needs: verify a report outcome before using it. The director has bribe-offer and bribe-pressed scenes.
gates: An improper offer has been made.

turns.what: The member writes down the details before contacting the ethics office.
turns.pulledBy: The officer taking reports is unavailable when the meeting ends.
turns.writesBack: The dated note and subsequent report remain separate records.

turns.what: The member reports the exchange that afternoon but cannot supply the visitor’s name.
turns.pulledBy: The member recalls the words and time, and a receptionist keeps a separate sign-in sheet.
turns.writesBack: The investigator receives a dated account with the visitor unidentified and requests the reception log.
